notes_for_editor: Only the provincial dataset and map data describe this tower. The 2017 date and 30 m height match our record. No earlier tower, staffing history, fire record or current access rule was found, so the story gives none. The brief's access 'closed' is not backed by a source I read, and the dataset's access mode 'fly' is the only access evidence, so no access fact is recorded. The 2017 date may mark a replacement, but no source says so. The Lakeside Leader and Alberta Historic Places pages are province-wide context and say nothing about this site. The web search budget for this tower was spent on two queries.
